definitions.explanation: A popular Japanese gambling game played on vertical machines where metal balls are shot and fall through pins, with prizes exchangeable for cash at separate locations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧パチンコ⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are many pachinko parlors in front of the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧パチンコ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: My father often goes to play pachinko on weekends.

examples.japanese: パチンコ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大当|おおあ}たり→大当たり：15927_ooatari⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I hit the jackpot at pachinko.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
Pachinko is one of Japan's most popular forms of gambling entertainment. Due to gambling laws, pachinko parlors cannot directly pay cash prizes. Instead, players exchange their balls for prizes, which can then be sold for cash at nearby exchange shops.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- パチンコ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧ (to play pachinko)
- パチンコ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ (to go to pachinko)
- パチンコ⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧/パチンコ⟦{店|てん}→店：10011_ten⟧ (pachinko parlor)
- ⟦{大当|おおあ}たり→大当たり：15927_ooatari⟧ (jackpot)

ETYMOLOGY:
The name comes from the onomatopoeia パチン (the sound of balls hitting pins).

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦スロット→スロット：08841_surotto⟧ (slot machines, often found in same parlors)
